story_title: PRD: PROPWR Genset Monitoring Portfolio Demo

architecture_decisions.stack: Plain static files, no framework, no build step; deployable to GitHub Pages and via run.sh locally

files.data/schema.json: canonical tag definitions, versioned, single source of truth for both OEM panels
files.js/simulation.js: telemetry generation, wobble, fault logic, validation (no DOM)
files.js/view.js: pure view-model helpers (added in Code so render logic is unit-testable)
files.js/render.js: map, panel, gauges, sparklines, modal, toast (DOM + Leaflet)

architecture_decisions.data_model: Site -> Genset (asset) -> live telemetry tags; both OEMs resolve tags through schema.json
architecture_decisions.fleet_scope: Cat G3520 (PWR2.6-S, PWR2.6-M) and Waukesha 9394S5 (PWR2.0); Solar Taurus 60 (PWR5.7) deferred
architecture_decisions.palette: slate background, green healthy, amber alarm, no red
architecture_decisions.tests: vitest (dev dependency only, no runtime deps); browser IIFE modules loaded through a vm helper in tests/helpers/load-module.js

Adjust WOBBLE_MAX or nominalFor if the bound is violated.

hints.notes: Math.random is used inside the SUT. tasks.name: Build js/render.js and index.html: map, panel, schema modal, toast, 1 s loop
tasks.description: Wire the page: load data/schema.json and data/sites.json with relative fetch, Sim.init, Leaflet map with CARTO dark basemap centered on Texas, one divIcon pin per site using View.pinClass, header KPIs via View.formatKpis, site panel with genset cards (OEM badge per docs/research/brand-and-specs.md recommendation, unit, model, serial, status dot, two SVG arc gauges via View.gaugeArc, tag table with quality badges and sparklines via View.sparklinePoints, alarm banner), Start/Stop/Load setpoint controls routed through View.controlGuard to a toast, Schema modal from View.schemaRows, Simulate Fault and Clear Fault buttons, footer disclaimer, setInterval 1000 Sim.tick. Automated tests cover the static structure; the browser behavior is Manual verification only per AC-8, AC-10, AC-17, AC-18. Every button carries a title attribute with mouse-over help (what it does, or that it is monitor-only); the page test asserts the titles are present and non-empty.
